# T001 — Stabilizing baseline and establishing npm test

## Summary

Baseline before T001: root `npm ci` passed, frontend build failed for missing Rollup Linux x64 GNU native package, `npm test` had no script or discoverable tests, and lint passed with five warnings. After T001: clean install and build pass, five characterization tests pass (zero failed/skipped), and lint passes with the same five warnings. Validation ran on Linux x86_64, Node v22.23.3 and npm 10.9.9, with `CI=true`, `TZ=UTC`, `LANG=C.UTF-8`.

## Changes

- `package.json`: Root `npm test` uses `node --import tsx --test test/*.test.mjs` and declares `tsx` as a development dependency, so the existing TypeScript characterization tests run on the declared Node >=22.0.0 range.
- `test/transaction-utils.test.mjs`: TestAuthor added five tests for existing transaction script, phone, currency, duration and status behavior; retained unchanged.
- `package-lock.json`: Restored missing Linux x64 GNU optional package records for Rollup 4.52.5, Lightning CSS 1.30.2, Tailwind oxide 4.1.16 and SWC core 1.13.21; added `tsx` 4.20.6 and its npm-resolved dependency records. No versions of existing packages changed, and the backend lockfile was not touched.

## Decisions

- Repaired the native packages in the root lock with npm package-manager commands: temporary `npm install --package-lock-only --save-optional` of each exact native package version, `npm pkg delete` of each temporary direct declaration and `npm install --package-lock-only` to synchronize. An ordinary lock-only install left the native record absent; generating a new lock from scratch would have changed thousands of lines and dependency versions. This addresses successive clean-build native-load failures without changing application behavior. Sources: root lock's existing optional dependency declarations and build logs.
- Review fix: `--experimental-strip-types` was introduced in Node 22.6, but all package engines allow Node 22.0.0. Installed `tsx@4.20.6` using `npm install --save-dev --workspace-root tsx@4.20.6` (its declared engine is `>=18.0.0`) and replaced only the test loader, preserving Node's native test runner, test discovery and assertions. `npm exec --yes --package=node@22.0.0 -- node --import tsx --test test/*.test.mjs` passed all five tests on the actual minimum Node version; no application source changed.
- The requested on-disk `plan.md` was absent; the approved T001 task and exact gates were available in the run state. Assessment baseline: `.github/modernization/e665c80e-0dd1-46fa-bb78-e6f89641d287/assessment.md`.

## Validation

Exact commands, all run **after the final manifest, lockfile and note edits**; the minimum-version runner check above ran after the manifest and lockfile edits:

| Command | Result |
|---|---|
| `npm ci` | Passed; clean install |
| `npm run build --if-present` | Passed; Vite built frontend |
| `npm test` | Passed; TAP: 5 tests, 5 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped |
| `npm run lint --if-present` | Passed; five pre-existing ESLint warnings |

Before the final native repairs, a successful `npm ci` exposed missing Lightning CSS and Tailwind oxide binaries on successive builds. Each was repaired in the same root lockfile using npm, and the final full gates pass.

## Follow-ups and risks

- Characterization covers only transaction utilities; backend HTTP/cloud integration and frontend HTTP behavior need later planned tests. No live Azure services were used.
- The existing five lint warnings and dependency-audit findings remain for later tasks. This task validates Linux x64 GNU; other platforms were not tested. The requested `plan.md` is still missing on disk.
